AGAWAN NG KABLE SA TONDO  

Nauwi sa gulo ang isang sunog sa Aroma, Barangay 105 sa Tondo, Maynila matapos mag-agawan sa kable ang ilang lalaki sa lugar nitong Miyerkules, August 6.  

Iniharap na kay Manila Mayor Isko Moreno ang dalawa sa mga nakuhaang nagnanakaw ng kable sa viral video.  

“‘Di ba kakasabi lang natin, gusto natin mabilis ang pagbangon ng mga kababayan nating tinamaan ng sunog? Pero sa ginawa nila, lalo pang bumagal ang proseso at naperwisyo pa — dahil paano makakabalik ang kuryente kung ninakaw ‘yung mga wire?,” saad ni Moreno. | via Gio Robles

data.text: It needs to be further stressed that "near geographic location" and "a large amount of Filipinos in Taiwan" should not be used as pretexts to interfere in the internal and sovereign affairs of other countries. These claims not only contravene international law and the ASEAN Charter, but also harm regional peace and stability and the fundamental interests of its own people. We urge the Philippines to earnestly abide by the one-China principle and the spirit of China-Philippines Joint Communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic relations, and refrain from playing fire on issues bearing on China's core interests, said the spokesperson.

quoted_tweet.text: In response to Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos Jr's recent remarks on Taiwan in an interview during his visit to India, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson said that China firmly opposes this. The Chinese Foreign Ministry and Embassy in the Philippines have lodged serious protests with the Philippine side. The Philippine government has made serious commitments to China that it adheres to the one-China policy, recognizes that Taiwan is an integral part of the Chinese territory and understands the Chinese government’s efforts to realize national reunification.  But, the Philippines is now going back on its words in disregard of the grave consequences. It has kept making wrong and provocative remarks and actions, kept fudging and hollowing out the one-China principle, and kept harming the China-Philippines relations. https://t.co/GiqQVjXOr9
